description: Delete plans/aiProfiles.agents/enableModule/types. ACP ids live on roster entries (claude-acp, gemini) and endpoint variants (claude-glm -> glm-acp-agent); Zed collects ACP ids from active agents. claude-glm defaults on with features.ai inside its own module and owns its sops-secret assertion; claude-firefly enabled only by firefly policy. Keep programs.aiApis; drop aiActiveBackend + backends catalog. Darwin features.llm -> programs.lm-studio (sets user.programs.aiApis.openai-compatible directly). Zed edit-prediction gate reads only aiApis; gemma model + max_output_tokens move into zed-editor settings.
title: Dissolve the AI catalog/profiles module
